Perks › Common

Zero Hero

Common perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, a bone containing a blank adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

When your scoring play uses a bone with at least one blank half (0-1 through 0-6, and the double blank), the play gains +5 points for each copy.

  • A blank that played as a wild card still counts as a blank bone.
  • Combines well with Wild Blank and Counterfeit Pip, which make blanks much easier to place.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlocked from the start of every career.
